name: whm
description: WHM-compatible web hosting control panel: Node.js + Express API, root agent daemon, React SPA, SQLite

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --prefix hub/ui
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm test --prefix plugins/sdk && npm test --prefix plugins/sample-plugin && for d in plugins/bundled/*/; do npm test --prefix "$d" || exit 1; done
